summary: Overdue 75-year-old male hunter near Dice Hill, SW Grand County (dressed in blue ski jacket under orange hoodie and jeans, no pack, no light, no fire-making ability). GCSAR teams entered the field at 09:50 and found him at 10:13; he had become disoriented at dark and sheltered under a spruce tree.
location: Near Dice Hill, SW Grand County
notes: One of two overdue-hunter incidents handled in a single GCSAR response; kept as separate incidents.
